display_name: Bosch EDC16C41 Nissan Patrol GU V Wagon (23710-VS43B / ZD30CRD variants)
vehicles: Nissan Patrol GU V Wagon 3.0 TDI / ZD30CRD

checksum.description: Bosch EDC16 family typically uses multiple checksum regions + correction values. After modifications (e.g. maps, IQ, boost), recalculate and patch so all regions validate. Community tools (WinOLS, ECM Titanium) have routines; port public logic to Rust.
checksum.notes: No native XDF in reference yet - requires manual mapping or WinOLS export. Focus on diesel maps: Driver Wish (torque request), Injection Quantity (IQ), Boost setpoint, Rail pressure, EGR, VGT.

security_access.reference: Code for Device.md or edc16_seedkey.rs port

maps_and_xdf.notes: Manual or WinOLS generated maps needed. Common diesel tables: fuel quantity vs torque/speed, boost vs IQ, timing, smoke limit, etc. Generate base XDF or app-native defs from known addresses in the working bin.

notes: Matches REFERENCE_INDEX.md entry for Nissan Patrol EDC16C41. 23710-VS43B is the specific part for GU V Wagon variant. Build DB entry to enable auto-identification on connect and checksum correction before flashing modified bins. Safe OBD or bench read recommended for personal ECU.
